verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents dedicated built-in tools for people and finance search, enabled by `type` (docs-30). The Search API offers domain filtering and "advanced filtering" (docs-17, docs-2), but these are not vertical-specific category filters. Only one of the named verticals, finance, has concrete evidence. missing for 10: news vertical endpoint or filter, image search vertical, documented category/vertical filter parameters on the Search API, independent or hands-on corroboration of finance search.
